issues.issue: This line is about 63% of receipts and is recorded as 'other' because the form doesn't label it. For an agricultural society it is most likely fair/event income (charges for services/fees). 'other' is defensible under the last-resort rule; this is a judgment call.
An unexplained line that is most of the year's receipts. A person should confirm what it is (fair/event revenue versus grants, donations or loan proceeds) and whether it should be recategorized.
